relationships.evidence_quote: SNHG5 promotes SCN9A-encoded Nav1.7 expression by recruiting CDK9, thereby facilitating neuron loss and NP after spinal nerve injury

key_findings: SNHG5 and SCN9A are upregulated in DRG of CCI rats; SNHG5 knockdown suppresses SCN9A and alleviates pain, inflammation and neuronal apoptosis.
SNHG5 recruits CDK9 to enhance SCN9A/Nav1.7 expression, and SCN9A overexpression abolishes the benefit of SNHG5 deficiency.
